content: Guest checkout vs forced account creation: forced account creation causes around 23 percent cart abandonment; guest checkout lifts first-purchase conversion 10-45 percent (average 4-9 percent overall revenue lift); guest mobile completion around 26 percent higher. Trade-off: registered users convert on repeat purchase at a higher rate (64 percent vs 52 percent). Best pattern is guest checkout plus optional post-purchase account creation, which converts 30-50 percent of guests to accounts within 7 days.
